verseText: Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
meaning: We are blessed and truly happy when we have a fearful respect of God's power and live life God's way.

recall.question: Who is blessed?
choices: Those who fear the LORD and walk in His ways

meaning.question: What does fear of the LORD mean here?
choices: Deep respect that leads to obedience
Being terrified that He is cruel

application.prompt: Show your respect for God today by choosing one of His ways even when another way seems easier.
